title: Phantasy Star Collection (Japan) V1.003: native PS2 callback edit
summary: Skip one original PS2 callback call without an IP helper or later RAM write.
rationale: The inherited handler conditionally redirects PS2.EXE's 0602345C pointer from 06021B58 to the resident RTS/NOP at 0600083C after loading. Replace only the corresponding original JSR at 06023424 with NOP. Keep the native target literal, following NOP, caller epilogue, first-program handoff and IP unchanged. Complete source and production-decoder checks change exactly two of 422832 PS2 bytes. A 52000-frame paired interpreter run against the retained inherited IP handler reaches the actual PS2 load; all 868 video, nonblack and audio sample-count checkpoints match. Cumulative audio CRCs match 772/868, first difference at 46321, and complete PCM differs. This audio uncertainty, other paths and physical compatibility remain open. No copied handler, new routine or RAM patch writer is supplied; this is the inherited PS2 callback workaround, not an established CDON edit. Keep inactive and uninstalled.

writes.effect: Skip the native 06023424 JSR while preserving the following NOP and caller epilogue.
writes.reason: Remove that specific callback execution in PS2.EXE itself, without installing the inherited pointer writer.

guards.reason: Bind the unchanged native first-program call and 06020000 handoff literal.
